2.m: a woman, when warned, shall pay a fine of one hundred [paṇas], but a man two hundred; / if forbidden by both sides, the fine is the same as for adultery.

2.s:
sajātāv uttamo daṇḍa ānulomye tu madhyamaḥ /
prātilomye vadhaḥ puṃso nāryāḥ karṇādikartanam //
2.d:
सजाताव् उत्तमो दण्ड आनुलोम्ये तु मध्यमः ।
प्रातिलोम्ये वधः पुंसो नार्याः कर्णादिकर्तनम् ॥
2.m: In the same social class, the highest fine applies; but in direct order of classes, the middling fine; / in reverse order of classes, death for the man, and cutting off of the ears and other limbs for the woman.

2.s:
alaṃkṛtāṃ haran kanyām uttamaṃ hy anyathādhamam /
daṇḍaṃ dadyāt savarṇāsu prātilomye vadhaḥ smṛtaḥ //
2.d:
अलंकृतां हरन् कन्याम् उत्तमं ह्य् अन्यथाधमम् ।
दण्डं दद्यात् सवर्णासु प्रातिलोम्ये वधः स्मृतः ॥
2.m: Carrying off an adorned maiden [of the same class], he shall pay the highest [fine]; but if unadorned, the lowest / fine among women of equal social class; in reverse order of classes, death is prescribed.

2.s:
sakāmāsv anulomāsu na doṣas tv anyathā damaḥ /
dūṣaṇe tu karaccheda uttamāyāṃ vadhas tathā //
2.d:
सकामास्व् अनुलोमासु न दोषस् त्व् अन्यथा दमः ।
दूषणे तु करच्छेद उत्तमायां वधस् तथा ॥
2.m: With willing women in direct order of classes there is no fault, but otherwise there is a fine; / but for violating [an unwilling maiden], amputation of the hand; and with a woman of a higher class, death.

2.s:
śataṃ strīdūṣaṇe dadyād dve tu mithyābhiśaṃsane /
paśūn gacchan śataṃ dāpyo hīnāṃ strīṃ gāṃ ca madhyamam //
2.d:
शतं स्त्रीदूषणे दद्याद् द्वे तु मिथ्याभिशंसने ।
पशून् गच्छन् शतं दाप्यो हीनां स्त्रीं गां च मध्यमम् ॥
2.m: One shall pay one hundred for defaming a woman, but two hundred for a false accusation. / Having intercourse with beasts, one is made to pay one hundred; with a degraded woman and a cow, the middling fine.

2.s:
avaruddhāsu dāsīsu bhujiṣyāsu tathaiva ca /
gamyāsv api pumān dāpyaḥ pañcāśat paṇikaṃ damam //
2.d:
अवरुद्धासु दासीसु भुजिष्यासु तथैव च ।
गम्यास्व् अपि पुमान् दाप्यः पञ्चाशत् पणिकं दमम् ॥
2.m: With kept female slaves and maidservants, / even if sexually approachable, a man shall be made to pay a fine of fifty paṇas.

2.s:
prasahya dāsyabhigame daṇḍo daśapaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ /
bahūnāṃ yady akāmāsau caturviṃśatikaḥ pṛthak //
2.d:
प्रसह्य दास्यभिगमे दण्डो दशपणः स्मृतः ।
बहूनां यद्य् अकामासौ चतुर्विंशतिकः पृथक् ॥
2.m: For forcibly having intercourse with a female slave, a fine of ten paṇas is prescribed; / if by many men when she is unwilling, twenty-four [paṇas] each.

2.s:
gṛhītavetanā veśyā necchantī dviguṇaṃ vahet /
agṛhīte samaṃ dāpyaḥ pumān apy evam eva hi //
2.d:
गृहीतवेतना वेश्या नेच्छन्ती द्विगुणं वहेत् ।
अगृहीते समं दाप्यः पुमान् अप्य् एवम् एव हि ॥
2.m: A courtesan who has received her fee and is unwilling shall pay double; / if the fee has not been received, equal. A man likewise, indeed.

2.s:
ayonau gacchato yoṣāṃ puruṣaṃ vābhimehataḥ /
caturviṃśatiko daṇḍas tathā pravrajitāgame //
2.d:
अयोनौ गच्छतो योषां पुरुषं वाभिमेहतः ।
चतुर्विंशतिको दण्डस् तथा प्रव्रजितागमे ॥
2.m: For having intercourse with a woman in an unnatural orifice, or discharging semen upon a man, / the fine is twenty-four [paṇas]; likewise for having intercourse with a female renunciant.

2.s:
antyābhigamane tv aṅkyaḥ kubandhena pravāsayet /
śūdras tathāntya eva syād antyasyāryāgame vadhaḥ //
2.d:
अन्त्याभिगमने त्व् अङ्क्यः कुबन्धेन प्रवासयेत् ।
शूद्रस् तथान्त्य एव स्याद् अन्त्यस्यार्यागमे वधः ॥
2.m: Upon having intercourse with an outcaste woman, he should be branded with an ignominious mark and banished; / a Shudra would become an outcaste himself; for an outcaste having intercourse with an Aryan woman, death.

2.s:
ūnaṃ vābhyadhikaṃ vāpi likhed yo rājaśāsanam /
pāradārikacauraṃ vā muñcato daṇḍa uttamaḥ //
2.d:
ऊनं वाभ्यधिकं वापि लिखेद् यो राजशासनम् ।
पारदारिकचौरं वा मुञ्चतो दण्ड उत्तमः ॥
2.m: Whoever writes less or more in a royal edict, / or releases an adulterer or a thief, faces the highest fine.

2.s:
abhakṣyeṇa dvijaṃ dūṣyo daṇḍya uttamasāhasam /
madhyamaṃ kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ prathamaṃ śūdram ardhikam //
2.d:
अभक्ष्येण द्विजं दूष्यो दण्ड्य उत्तमसाहसम् ।
मध्यमं क्षत्रियं वैश्यं प्रथमं शूद्रम् अर्धिकम् ॥
2.m: Corrupting a twice-born with inedible food, one should be fined the highest heinous offence; / a Kshatriya, the middling; a Vaishya, the first; a Shudra, half.

2.s:
kūṭasvarṇavyavahārī vimāṃsasya ca vikrayī /
tryaṅgahīnas tu kartavyo dāpyaś cottamasāhasam //
2.d:
कूटस्वर्णव्यवहारी विमांसस्य च विक्रयी ।
त्र्यङ्गहीनस् तु कर्तव्यो दाप्यश् चोत्तमसाहसम् ॥
2.m: A dealer in counterfeit gold and a seller of forbidden meat / must be deprived of three limbs and made to pay the highest heinous offence fine.

2.s:
catuṣpādakṛto doṣo nāpehīti prajalpataḥ /
kāṣṭhaloṣṭeṣupāṣāṇabāhuyugyakṛtas tathā //
2.d:
चतुष्पादकृतो दोषो नापेहीति प्रजल्पतः ।
काष्ठलोष्टेषुपाषाणबाहुयुग्यकृतस् तथा ॥
2.m: No fault attaches to the driver who shouts: 'Get out of the way!' for harm caused by a quadruped, / or caused by wood, clod, arrow, stone, arm, or yoked draught animal;

2.s:
chinnanasyena yānena tathā bhagnayugādinā /
paścāc caivāpasaratā hiṃsane svāmy adoṣabhāk //
2.d:
छिन्ननस्येन यानेन तथा भग्नयुगादिना ।
पश्चाच् चैवापसरता हिंसने स्वाम्य् अदोषभाक् ॥
2.m: nor by a carriage whose nose-rope has broken, or whose yoke or the like is shattered, / nor when it slips backwards: the owner incurs no guilt in case of injury.

2.s:
śakto 'py amokṣayan svāmī daṃṣṭriṇāṃ śṛṅgiṇāṃ tathā /
prathamaṃ sāhasaṃ dadyād vikruṣṭe dviguṇaṃ tathā //
2.d:
शक्तो ऽप्य् अमोक्षयन् स्वामी दंष्ट्रिणां शृङ्गिणां तथा ।
प्रथमं साहसं दद्याद् विक्रुष्टे द्विगुणं तथा ॥
2.m: An owner, though able, who does not release [animals] with fangs or with horns, / shall pay the first heinous offence fine; and twice that if an alarm was cried.

2.s:
jāraṃ caurety abhivadan dāpyaḥ pañcaśataṃ damam /
upajīvya dhanaṃ muñcaṃs tad evāṣṭaguṇīkṛtam //
2.d:
जारं चौरेत्य् अभिवदन् दाप्यः पञ्चशतं दमम् ।
उपजीव्य धनं मुञ्चंस् तद् एवाष्टगुणीकृतम् ॥
2.m: Calling a paramour a 'thief', one shall be made to pay a fine of five hundred; / releasing him after taking money, eight times that amount.

2.s:
rājño 'niṣṭapravaktāraṃ tasyaivākrośakāriṇam /
tanmantrasya ca bhettāraṃ chittvā jihvāṃ pravāsayet //
2.d:
राज्ञो ऽनिष्टप्रवक्तारं तस्यैवाक्रोशकारिणम् ।
तन्मन्त्रस्य च भेत्तारं छित्त्वा जिह्वां प्रवासयेत् ॥
2.m: One who speaks what is disagreeable to the king, one who reviles him, / and one who reveals his secret counsel: having cut out his tongue, he should banish him.

2.s:
mṛtāṅgalagnavikretur guros tāḍayitus tathā /
rājayānāsanāroḍhur daṇḍa uttamasāhasaḥ //
2.d:
मृताङ्गलग्नविक्रेतुर् गुरोस् ताडयितुस् तथा ।
राजयानासनारोढुर् दण्ड उत्तमसाहसः ॥
2.m: For a seller of clothes taken from the limbs of a corpse, for a striker of a guru, / and for an mounter of the king's carriage or throne, the fine is the highest heinous offence.

2.s:
dvinetrabhedino rājadviṣṭādeśakṛtas tathā /
vipratvena ca śūdrasya jīvato 'ṣṭaśato damaḥ //
2.d:
द्विनेत्रभेदिनो राजद्विष्टादेशकृतस् तथा ।
विप्रत्वेन च शूद्रस्य जीवतो ऽष्टशतो दमः ॥
2.m: For one who blinds both eyes, for one who executes a command hostile to the king, / and for a Shudra living by claiming Brahminhood, the fine is eight hundred.

2.s:
durdṛṣṭāṃs tu punar dṛṣṭvā vyavahārān nṛpeṇa tu /
sabhyāḥ sajayino daṇḍyā vivādād dviguṇaṃ damam //
2.d:
दुर्दृष्टांस् तु पुनर् दृष्ट्वा व्यवहारान् नृपेण तु ।
सभ्याः सजयिनो दण्ड्या विवादाद् द्विगुणं दमम् ॥
2.m: When lawsuits improperly judged are reconsidered by the king, / the court assessors together with the winning party are to be fined twice the penalty of the suit.

2.s:
yo manyetājito 'smīti nyāyenāpi parājitaḥ /
tam āyāntaṃ punar jitvā dāpayed dviguṇaṃ damam //
2.d:
यो मन्येताजितो ऽस्मीति न्यायेनापि पराजितः ।
तम् आयान्तं पुनर् जित्वा दापयेद् द्विगुणं दमम् ॥
2.m: He who thinks 'I am not defeated' although defeated in accordance with justice, / having defeated him again when he comes back, the king shall make him pay double the fine.

2.s:
rājñānyāyena yo daṇḍo gṛhīto varuṇāya tam /
nivedya dadyād viprebhyaḥ svayaṃ triṃśadguṇīkṛtam //
2.d:
राज्ञान्यायेन यो दण्डो गृहीतो वरुणाय तम् ।
निवेद्य दद्याद् विप्रेभ्यः स्वयं त्रिंशद्गुणीकृतम् ॥
2.m: Whatever fine has been unlawfully taken by the king, having offered it to Varuṇa, / he should give it to Brahmins, increased thirtyfold by himself.
